summary: Created a 9-phase implementation plan (9 hours, 6 dependency waves) covering all four confirmed defects plus one planning-time discovery. Phases: fix the four subshell-discarded counter blocks in validate-context-index.sh; build a source-store line_count regenerator; regenerate ~320 counts across all extensions; convert append_index_entries to upsert and add the version/generated stamp; index the 14 orphaned context files; redeploy and verify; add two new lettered gates to check-extension-docs.sh; documentation sync; final verify-deploy gate. Key caveat: the deployed index merge is currently append-only-with-dedupe, so without the merge.lua change the task's own verification bar would be unreachable.
decisions_made: Added a phase (4) not called for by the research: M.append_index_entries in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua is append-only with dedupe-by-path and never updates an existing entry, and sync.lua excludes index.json from context copy -- so corrected source line_count values would never reach the deployed index. Converted to upsert, which also gives the version/generated stamp a natural home.

Line-count mismatches stay WARNING severity in validate-context-index.sh (exit code still driven by errors only), with an opt-in --strict flag rather than an immediate hard-fail promotion -- avoids a severity regression while still satisfying the nonzero-before/zero-after verification bar.

Chose remediate-then-gate ordering over the advisory-to-hard two-phase rollout: index entries and line counts land in phases 3/5/6, the new gates land hard in phase 7 against an already-clean baseline. A sibling severity variable is still introduced as an escape hatch.

Both new gates go in check-extension-docs.sh per the research recommendation: a per-extension source line_count rule (catches the 94 nulls in unloaded extensions the deployed validator can never see) and a project-wide deployed-index-orphan rule. No change to verify-deploy.sh, which already invokes gate 3 in full.
The new regenerator script is declared in the core manifest provides.scripts in the same phase it is created, so the existing Rule Q undeclared-scripts check stays clean.

Every phase carries an explicit Scope Hypothesis instructing the implementer to re-derive the asserted counts (444/226/94 entries, 14 orphans, four defective pipelines) live rather than trusting the plan's figures.
dead_ends: Regenerating line_count only in the deployed .claude/context/index.json: it is a disposable deploy artifact regenerated from agent-system/extensions/**, so the correction is silently undone on the next redeploy. The generator must target the source store.
Adding the new gates to validate-context-index.sh: that script is invoked by nothing automated (manual tool, referenced only from a docs guide), so a gate there would never run.
Adding a new verify-deploy.sh gate: unnecessary, since gate 3 already invokes check-extension-docs.sh in full and picks up new rules automatically.
